source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: الأسبوع الماضي، كان في عرس ابن عمي.
sentences.en: Last week, there was my cousin's wedding.

sentences.ar: العيلة كلها اجتمعت من كل البلاد.
sentences.en: The whole family gathered from all the towns.
The women prepared the food and the sweets.
We put on our nicest clothes and went to the hall.

sentences.ar: كان في دبكة وغنا وناس كتير.
sentences.en: There was dabke, singing, and lots of people.

sentences.ar: العروس كانت لابسة أبيض وحلوة كتير.
sentences.en: The bride was wearing white and was very beautiful.
We danced and laughed until late at night.
My grandmother was the happiest one at the wedding.

sentences.ar: رجعنا عالبيت تعبانين بس القلب مبسوط.
sentences.en: We went home tired but our hearts were happy.
